summary: Inside a space, the wide bar showed "⌄ Minimize", "‹ Chess" and the room's name side by side, and the phone an unlabelled arrow, so it was unclear which control went back and which left the room. A space now has one back control, named for the place it leads to (the space from a game's own menu, the game from a screen the game opens); Minimize is a row in the space settings sheet.
